Definition: Whether non-nationals including refugees, asylum seekers, and permanent residents are eligible to register
Comments: The WURI (World Bank) foundational ID system, of which Niger is a Phase 2 participant, is explicitly designed for 'all persons physically in the territory of a country, irrespective of nationality, citizenship or legal status.' This inclusive approach covers refugees, stateless persons, and non-nationals. The WURI PAD confirms this universal coverage principle.
